programs.title: Secret In Their Eyes
programs.desc: A tight-knit FBI team is torn apart when the daughter of one of the agents is raped and murdered, and the case goes unsolved. Years later, a member of the team uncovers a new clue that he hopes will allow him to bring the killer to justice. However, the victim's grieving mother is dissatisfied with the law and takes matters into her own hands.

programs.title: Finding Dawn
programs.desc: Filmmaker Christine Welsh brings us a compelling documentary that puts a human face on a national tragedy -the epidemic of missing or murdered Indigenous women in Canada. The film takes a journey into the heart of these women's experience, from Vancouver's skid row, down the Highway of Tears in northern BC, and on to Saskatoon, where the murders and disappearances of these women remain unsolved.
